assignments.notes: Schema design for lens configuration — defines workshop rules, UX principles, activation mechanism, and runtime loading pattern. Foundation for all subsequent tasks.
Empathy and user context prompts (3+). Must follow Design Thinking Lens rules defined in DESIGN-001. Outputs are reusable templates with placeholders producing artifact files.
Research and landscape prompts (3+). Competitor analysis produces matrix artifact. Follows Scan Before Read principle.
Framing and assumption prompts (4+). Assumption surfacing extracts 5+ assumptions from project descriptions. Prioritization uses risk matrix. Outputs feed into Blueprint phase inputs.

assignments.context_load: PRD initiative-02, DISC-001 output, DISC-002 output, DISC-003 output
assignments.notes: 5 artifact templates in .skillweave/templates/discovery/. Must be fillable from discovery prompt outputs. YAML template for assumption log needs syntax validation.
Ideation module with quantity-first generation, deferred judgment, wild idea flagging, and expansion mode. Configurable via lens settings from DESIGN-001.
Assumption extraction and tracking with impact × probability categorization. Persists to .skillweave/tracking-log/assumptions.yaml. Depends on DISC-003 for extraction patterns.
Iteration quality framework with feedback synthesis, evidence-driven revision, and learning extraction. Iteration log persists in .skillweave/tracking-log/.

assignments.context_load: PRD initiative-02, FEAT-001 output, FEAT-002 output, FEAT-003 output, TMPL-001 output, DESIGN-001 output
assignments.notes: Integration layer connecting Design Thinking Lens to Blueprint and PromptChain skills. Requires all features and templates complete. Backward compatibility is mandatory.
Test suite with 12+ test cases covering prompt library completeness, template validation, lens configuration, ideation mode, assumption tracking, and backward compatibility.

parallel_groups.rationale: All depend only on DESIGN-001. Prompt authoring and early feature work can proceed concurrently after lens schema is defined.
Templates depend on all prompt libraries being complete. Single task group.
Assumption tracking depends on DISC-003 (assumption surfacing prompt). Can run in parallel with TMPL-001 since both depend on the prompt phase but not each other.
Integration requires all features and templates. Single task, no parallelism within group.
Testing requires integration complete. Final group.
